detail.longDescription: Portus is a Rust-based API/AI/MCP Gateway built on top of Rama as the networking stack (Rama replaced Pingora due to better throughput and lower resource usage). Portus uses a split control/data plane architecture and conforms with the Kubernetes Gateway API specification (130/130 tests across all profiles). Portus also runs in standalone mode outside of Kubernetes with a simple Yaml config file with ACME support built-in. Please give it a try and if you like it then if you wouldn't mind going to Github and starring the project I would be very appreciative! If there is something missing that you would like to see then please leave feedback and I will see what I can do. Thank you! https://github.com/Portus-Gateway/Portus
